name: spectral-vocoder
description:
A vocoder without a filter bank: the carrier takes the spectral envelope of
the voice.

An envelope is a magnitude spectrum averaged over neighbouring bins
(bin_blur), which keeps the formants and loses the pitch.  The carrier is
divided by its own envelope to flatten it, then multiplied by the voice's.

spectrograms.label: Chirp (0 Hz → Nyquist over 5 s → decay)
